# reselling_vpc_route (Resource)

A static route of a VPC: `destination` via the private IP of a member. Routes are stored and shown with guest commands; they are not pushed into the guests automatically. Import with `vpc_id/route_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_vpc_route" "office" {
  vpc_id      = reselling_vpc.backend.id
  destination = "192.168.50.0/24"
  next_hop    = reselling_vpc_member.web.private_ip
  description = "office network via a gateway server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation, outside the VPC and not 0.0.0.0/0.
- `next_hop` (String) Private IP of a member of the VPC.
- `vpc_id` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_vpc_route.office <vpc_id>/<route_id>
```
